explanation: The indicial roots are 2 and −2. For the smaller root, substitution gives n(n−4)b_n+(n−3)b_{n−1}=0. Taking b₀=1 yields b₁=−2/3, b₂=1/6, and b₃=0; the resonance at n=4 causes no obstruction. Thus y₂=x⁻²−(2/3)x⁻¹+1/6 is an independent solution of form c. Form e also accommodates this solution with b₋₁=0. Frobenius solutions of ordinary differential equations are absent from the supplied course topics, so this is prerequisite.
